test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 26 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A × B means ‘A is the father of B’,

A ÷ B means ‘A is the sister of B’.

Based on the above, how is Q related to T if ‘P + Q – R × S ÷ T’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Father
 Sister
 
 

 

Given: P + Q – R × S ÷ T

It means: P is the mother of Q, Q is the brother of R, R is the father of S and S is the sister of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/656a1621fca7ec5e4f4f10e97c0b6d8e8a8a4a2d2e6aa37283e402b026014848.png] 

So, Q is the **Father's brother** of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Father's brother".
